families.evidence: The AI archive loader advances fixed 0x1720-byte pointer-free route records. StageTiming_RelocateCarRecordRoutePoints publishes their addresses and adds the route origin to x/z arrays; telemetry consumes heading/speed/x/z indexed samples.

StageTiming_InitRaceDriverRecords owns a 0xb0-byte stack block. BuildSplitInterpolationFactors writes four ten-word bands; fixed interpolation consumes those bands and the four numeric endpoint/blend parameters. The same block flows through sample refresh and CPU split sorting.
